title: Bounded coherent upper shriek for perfect finite-type maps
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to A$ be a finite-type homomorphism of commutative Noetherian rings such that $A$ is perfect over a polynomial presentation of $\varphi$, and let $\varphi^!:D(R)\to D(A)$ be the algebraic upper-shriek functor of [lem-trf-algebraic-shriek-calculus]. Then $\varphi^!$ sends complexes with bounded finitely generated cohomology over $R$ to complexes with bounded finitely generated cohomology over $A$. In particular, $\varphi^!(R[0])$ has bounded finitely generated cohomology over $A$.
